summary: Value-capture routine with a one-shot activation flag. If the override flag this+0x8 is non-zero, the input is always stored to this+0x10 and returned. Otherwise the input is captured into this+0x10 on the first activation (input non-zero while state this+0xC is zero, which then sets this+0xC = 1); a zero input resets the state flag this+0xC = 0 and clears the captured value, and a new non-zero input while already activated clears this+0x10 without re-capturing. Returns the original input in every path. Called from sub_4537B0 (0x004537B0).

operations.description: If override flag this+0x8 is non-zero, always capture: store a2 into this+0x10 and return a2, bypassing activation state.
First activation: when input a2 is non-zero and activation state this+0xC is zero, store a2 into this+0x10 and set this+0xC = 1.
Deactivation: when input a2 is zero, reset activation state this+0xC = 0.
Clear the captured value this+0x10 = 0 in the fall-through paths: either after a zero input, or after a new non-zero input while already activated (override off).
Return the original input a2 in all control-flow paths.
Invoked from sub_4537B0 (0x004537B0); existing analysis describes that caller as a per-frame collision-update path.
